text:
maya: Quick heads-up — I opened a tiny docs PR to clean up an embedded console example that has the wrong trace key and a cost/latency snippet that doesn't match our SDK outputs. Would love a quick review + merge before EOD if anyone's around :wave:

oliver: Can you drop the PR link? happy to eyeball it. :eyes:
maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1897 — main fixes:
- unify trace key to `x-rd-trace` across examples
- update cost breakdown numbers (they were stale from an old run)
- remove an orphaned `kv_prefetch` flag in the yaml sample

kevin: skimmed the diff — looks sensible. One thing: the node + python snippets diverged for the trace header name earlier this quarter, we should keep both consistent. Also the js sample still uses `response.costTokens` (old field) — update to `usage.tokens`?

maya: good catch. I changed the node snippet to `usage.tokens` but left a comment in the PR about verifying telemetry mapping in the runtime team.

priya: quick note on rollouts: since this touches the quickstart and console examples, can we also add a compatibility note for Dedicated customers who pin older SDKs? maybe a 1-liner: "If you rely on SDK < 2.3, the telemetry fields differ — see migration link"
maya: yep added that line and linked the migration doc (internal link).

oliver: heads-up: docs-bot flagged a broken link in the embed (CI). docs-bot, can you paste the failure logs?
docs-bot: CI check failed: 1 broken link in docs/console/quickstart.md line 132 -> /sdk/old-telemetry (404). Suggested fix: point to /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3.

kevin: easy fix, replace the href, maybe add a redirect in the site config so old links don't rot. I'll open a tiny site-config PR after this merges.

priya: is there any user-facing change we need to announce? If numbers in the cost/latency table changed notably, we should add a short changelog entry for the Console docs changelog.
maya: numbers changed by ~5-8% due to batching defaults updates — not huge but worth a short note. I added an "Update note" block under the quickstart.

oliver: i left 2 nits on wording, otherwise LGTM. maya, can you squash the tiny fixup and i'll merge during standup? :white_check_mark:
maya: will do, pushing a fixup now. thanks all! :pray:

kevin: created redirect PR linked in the PR description: https://github.com/redwood-inference/site-config/pull/212 — once this merges, old links will 301 to the migration page.

maya: merging once CI passes and redirect PR is green. thanks for the fast reviews :rocket:
